purpose: The standard every NOVELTY capability must follow so the Novelty gate (review stage) can call it as a research ACTION. Same 18-field schema as the theory/numerical specs; argus_skill/verticals/physics/capabilities/novelty.json conforms to it.
gate_checking_philosophy: The gate does NOT judge whether a contribution is 'truly novel'.
It checks: is every claim mapped to its closest prior work?
Is what is already-known separated from what is new?
Is significance (why it matters / who cares) stated?
Is claim wording calibrated to evidence strength?
If novelty is insufficient, are claims downgraded and the paper type kept honest?

required_fields.description: Short name of the novelty research action.
Where in NOVELTY_CLAIM_TABLE.csv is the evidence?
How a claim is downgraded if not done.
How to compare to prior work's claims.

gate_binding.feeds: PAPER_TYPE_CLASSIFIER.json (paper-type gate): if novelty is insufficient the paper type cannot be an original research article.

failure_codes.NOV-002: claim marked new but already-known not separated
failure_codes.NOV-004: all claims already known but paper_type_implication still original
